_method: Noise-map inflation applied to cutout_[cr_]noise.fits by make_cutouts.py (precedence: 1.0 < per-instrument value < _lens_overrides < explicit --corr-factor). NOT a drizzle correction: drizzle conserves noise, so 1/sqrt(WHT) is already right for any patch >= the drop. The excess is an ERR-array deficit (~10-20% rms in ACS/UVIS FLCs, white) plus, for WFC3/UVIS at low sky by 2023, noise from the pixel-based CTE correction. STATISTIC (2026-10-06): the PATCH-MEDIAN kernel-window ACF of scripts/measure_corr_factor.py -- sqrt of the floor-subtracted sigma-normalised blank-sky ACF summed over the drop window, computed on every 10" sub-patch of the +-30" region (6" around the lens left out, 3-sigma source mask) and medianed. The earlier region-wide ACF is pulled up by localised structure (star halos, large neighbours, the deflector's own outskirts: J2302-0840 F606W 12.5 region-wide vs 1.03 by patch; J0841+3824 F160W, a spiral, 2.29 vs 1.04). Band value = median over every stamp of that camera/band ACROSS samples (repo-wide, not per sample: the factor follows observing date and sky, which samples only proxy). Values measured 2026-10-06 on the shared bands: ACS/WFC f814W 1.17 (69 stamps: SLACS gold/other, BELLS, SL2S), WFPC2 f606W 1.04 (65), WFC3/IR f160W 1.00 (21; median 0.98, floored), WFC3/UVIS f475X 1.21 (30, SL2S), f600LP 1.19 (12, SL2S), ACS/WFC f606W 1.20 (1, J0217-0513). NOT re-measured with the patch statistic (their mosaics were not rebuilt after the 2026-10-04 purge; region-wide values from 2026-09-26): ACS/WFC f555W 1.17, WFC3/UVIS f438W 1.24, f606W 1.18, f814W 1.26 (gallery). OVERRIDE RULE: a lens gets its own value when its patch median is > 0.10 from the band median AND the band median lies outside the lens's own 16-84% patch range (the excess is uniform across its field). That gives the 11 low-sky (MDRIZSKY < ~29 e-) GO-17130 F475X fields, consistent with CTE-correction noise; the old J1143-0144 f814W 1.38 override was field structure and is gone. ACS f814W drifts 1.18 (2004-07) -> 1.20 (2010-11), inside its lens-to-lens scatter, so one value covers both; make_cutouts.epoch_factor supports epoch-keyed entries for a band whose break exceeds its scatter. Raw results: diagnostics/corr_factor/. See AGENTS.md *Drizzle correlated noise*.
